name: Rhodesia (1968–1979)
description: A green-white-green vertical triband bearing the Rhodesian coat of arms on the white centre.
history: Adopted on 11 November 1968, the third anniversary of Rhodesia's Unilateral Declaration of Independence, replacing the light-blue ensign; the green stood for the land and the white for the settlers. It flew until Zimbabwe Rhodesia adopted its own flag on 4 September 1979.
